an8.11:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Verañjāyaṃ viharati Naḷerupucimandamūle.
an8.11:1.3: Atha kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an8.11:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Verañjo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.11:2.2: na samaṇo Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetī ti.
an8.11:2.4: na hi bhavaṃ Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
an8.11:2.5: Tayidaṃ bho Gotama na sampannam evā' ti.
an8.11:2.6: ‘Nāhan taṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yam ahaṃ abhivādeyyaṃ vā paccuṭṭheyyaṃ vā āsanena vā nimanteyyaṃ.
an8.11:2.7: Yaṃ hi brāhmaṇa Tathāgato abhivādeyya vā paccuṭṭheyya vā āsanena vā nimanteyya, muddhā pi tassa vipateyyā' ti. 2.
an8.11:3.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:3.4: Ye te brāhmaṇa rūparasā saddarasā gandharasā rasarasā phoṭṭhabbarasā, te Tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.11:3.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:3.6: arasarūpo samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 3.
an8.11:4.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:4.4: Ye te brāhmaṇa rūpabhogā saddabhogā gandhabhogā rasabhogā phoṭṭhabbabhogā, te Tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.11:4.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:4.6: nibbhogo samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 4.
an8.11:5.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:5.4: hi brāhmaṇa akiriyaṃ vadāmi kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an8.11:5.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:5.6: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 5.
an8.11:6.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:6.4: hi brāhmaṇa ucchedaṃ vadāmi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmi.
an8.11:6.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:6.6: ucchedavādo samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 6.
an8.11:7.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:7.4: hi brāhmaṇa jigucchāmi kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, jigucchāmi anekavihitānaṃ papakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an8.11:7.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:7.6: jegucchī samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 7.
an8.11:8.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:8.4: hi brāhmaṇa vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa, anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.11:8.5: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:8.6: venayiko samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 8.
an8.11:9.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:9.4: Tapanīyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa pāpake akusale dhamme vadāmi, kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ.
an8.11:9.5: yassa kho brāhmaṇa tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tam ahaṃ tapassī ti vadāmi.
an8.11:9.6: Tathāgatassa kho brāhmaṇa tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.11:9.7: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:9.8: tapassī samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesī' ti. 9.
an8.11:10.2: ‘Atthi khv esa brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:10.4: Yassa kho brāhmaṇa āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tam ahaṃ apagabbho ti vadāmi.
an8.11:10.5: Tathāgatassa kho brāhmaṇa āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.11:10.6: Ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.11:10.7: apagabbho samaṇo Gotamo ti; no ca kho yaṃ tvaṃ sandhāya vadesi.
an8.11:11.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā,
an8.11:11.2: tān' assu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni;
an8.11:11.3: yo nu kho tesaṃ kukkuṭapotakānaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbijjheyya, kinti svāssa vacanīyo jeṭṭho vā kaniṭṭho vā' ti?
an8.11:11.4: ‘Jeṭṭho ti 'ssa bho Gotama vacanīyo, so hi nesaṃ bho Gotama jeṭṭho hotī' ti. 10. ‘Evam
an8.11:12.1: eva kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa avijjāgatāya pajāya aṇḍabhūtāya pariyonaddhāya avijjaṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā eko 'va loke anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho.
an8.11:12.2: Ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa jeṭṭho seṭṭho lokassa.
an8.11:13.1: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me brāhmaṇa viriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apamuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ. 11.
an8.11:13.2: ‘So kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ;
an8.11:13.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ;
an8.11:13.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno, sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ, yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī ti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ;
an8.11:13.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. 12.
an8.11:14.1: ‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
an8.11:14.2: So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi, seyyathīdaṃ ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo catasso pi jātiyo pañca pi jātiyo dasa pi jātiyo vīsam pi jātiyo tiṃsam pi jātiyo cattāḷīsam pi jātiyo paññāsam pi jātiyo, jātisatam pi jātisahassam pi jātisatasahassam pi, aneke pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe "amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno" ti. Iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
an8.11:15.1: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā,
an8.11:15.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an8.11:15.3: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa paṭhamā abhinibbidhā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakass' eva aṇḍakosamhā. 13.
an8.11:16.1: ‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
an8.11:16.2: So dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne, hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi "ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā" ti. Iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne, hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi.
an8.11:17.1: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā vijjā adhigatā,
an8.11:17.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātapino pahitattassa viharato.
an8.11:17.3: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa dutiyā abhinibbidhā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakass' eva aṇḍakosamhā. 14.
an8.11:18.1: ‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
an8.11:18.2: So "idaṃ dukkhan" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ dukkhanirodho" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ;
an8.11:18.3: "ime āsavā" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ āsavasamudayo" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ āsavanirodho" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, "ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā" ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
an8.11:18.4: Tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccittha, bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccittha, avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccittha,
an8.11:18.6: "Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā" ti abbhaññāsiṃ.
an8.11:19.1: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā,
an8.11:19.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā, tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
an8.11:19.3: Ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tatiyā abhinibbidhā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakass' eva aṇḍakosamhā' ti. 15.
an8.11:20.1: Evaṃ vutte Verañjo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an8.11:20.2: Jeṭṭho bhavaṃ Gotamo, seṭṭho bhavaṃ Gotamo.
an8.11:20.3: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama,
an8.11:20.4: seyyathā pi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī' ti: evam eva bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an8.11:20.5: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca,
an8.11:20.6: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
